science_notes.native_f32_correspondence_vs_accuracy: Agreement between native and F32 token log-probs on probed contexts shows the numerical path is consistent, so a later change is less likely numerical drift. It does not show the policy is more accurate.
science_notes.paired_baseline: With balanced labels, a same-input paired B-A comparison can still reflect a shifted answer prior rather than better visual reading. The measured endpoint is an engineering B-A classification difference under the same inputs, not causal anatomical proof; no extra ablation is mandated by this note.
